content.title: Clinical Practice Guidelines Committee 2022-2024 - Declarations of Interest (page)

entries.declaration: Membership or affiliation in political or advocacy groups working in the field of cardiology. Supports British charity CardiomyopathyUK and Pumping Marvellous. Member of the Coalition for Reducing Bureaucracy in Clinical Trials (no financial interest). Savings and pensions held in shares managed by a financial adviser; does not control purchase & sale of shares and does not know whether any shares are in medical companies.

Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc. Pfizer: Atrial fibrillation. Membership or affiliation in political, advocacy or patients organisations working in cardiology. Medical advisor to the Atrial Fibrillation Alliance.
Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc. Pfizer: Atrial Fibrillation (AF).

Any other interest (financial or otherwise) that should be declared in view of holding an ESC position. Received research funding to institution for independent research from the Danish Heart Foundation and the Novo Nordisk Foundation.

Payment from healthcare industry to department or institution or any other body for personal services: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc. Daiichi Sankyo: general cardiology. Servier: general cardiology. Philips: imaging. Membership or affiliation in political, advocacy or patients organisations working in cardiology. Member of the Belgian Society of Cardiology.
